tables.ST_02_2005005_4: labor force status (employed/unemployed/seasonal-waiting) x sex x province, quarterly
tables.LFS_02_20546_01: employed persons by age group x province, quarterly (sex-combined)

gaps_not_available_at_province_level: Employment by industry (LFS_02_20535_8) and by occupation (LFS_02_20535_7) are published only down to ภาค (region, 6 regions), never จังหวัด (province, 77) — confirmed by inspecting every resource under CKAN package 0706_02_0002.

Informal vs formal employment counts (OS_02_0007_* informal, OS_02_0006_* formal) are published by sex/age/occupation/industry or by ภาค (region) only — no province breakdown exists in the catalog (checked package 0706_02_0007 / 0706_02_0006). The already-vendored source-data/employment_by_province.json (76 provinces, formal/informal head-counts) predates this ingest and is NOT an NSO-catalog province table by this method — left untouched, provenance unverified by this run.

Average wage/earnings: the only wage table is LFS_02_20545_18, region x industry x quarter (already vendored as source-data/nso_wages.json via pipeline/pull_nso_wages.py) — no province-level wage table exists in the catalog (checked package 0706_02_0019).

Underemployment (ผู้ทำงานต่ำระดับด้านชั่วโมงการทำงาน): tables 0706_02_0014/0706_02_0025 publish only a national rate/count by age group or sex — no province breakdown found (explicit catalog search for province-level underemployment returned 0 results).
